about_the_game:
A massive AI-controlled spaceship hovers above a desolate desert planet — its mission: create biological life and exploit it for resource gathering. You are one of its human clones. Congratulations!

Alone or in co-op with other players, you’re dropped onto the planet’s surface to collect resources and regularly ship them to the AI, hoping to keep it satisfied... and avoid becoming its next target.

But you’re not alone down there. Waves of monsters will attack relentlessly. To survive, you'll need to research and craft weapons — often with ridiculous, hilarious effects — that let you fight back in style.

Earn wealth, unlock vehicles and personal apartments, build up your defenses — and once you’re ready, challenge the AI mothership itself and bring the whole system crashing down.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400
  • Memory: 6 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1070
  • Storage: 12 GB available space

short_description: Stranded on a desert planet by an AI mothership, you and other cloned humans must gather resources, survive monster attacks, craft ridiculous weapons, and send shipments to the AI to avoid its wrath. Build wealth, own vehicles and apartments — or rise up and destroy your AI overlord.
